title: The Littlest Light
hook: EXTREME CLOSE-UP on a single fading golden spark flickering under a sunflower leaf at dusk — then it goes dark.

scenes.goal: A tiny light is going out and Pip is the only one who notices.
scenes.visualDesc: Extreme close-up: a tiny golden firefly spark flickers weakly under the curl of a sunflower leaf, then dims to almost nothing. Pip leans into frame at the edge, huge eyes catching the last glow, beak parting in a soft gasp.
scenes.endPose: leaning in, beak open mid-gasp, one wingtip lifted toward the dim spark
scenes.motionDesc: Camera holds tight as the spark pulses once and fades; Pip drifts into the edge of frame and freezes, eyes widening at the dying light.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Oh! The little light... it's going out!

scenes.goal: Pull back to reveal the lost, shivering firefly among the sunflower stalks.
scenes.visualDesc: Medium shot pulling back: Pip crouches low between two tall sunflower stalks, looking down at a tiny dim firefly trembling on a leaf, its glow the size of a seed.
scenes.endPose: crouched low, head tilted gently over the tiny firefly
scenes.motionDesc: Camera eases back from the close-up to show Pip and the little firefly together; Pip lowers herself slowly, careful not to startle it.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Hello, little one. Why is your light so small?

scenes.goal: Establish the firefly is different — it hums 'kwak', not a peep — and Pip is gentle with it.
scenes.visualDesc: Close two-shot of Pip and the firefly on its leaf; Pip dips her head closer, listening, as the firefly gives a tiny shivering hum instead of a chirp.
scenes.endPose: ear turned to the firefly, a soft delighted smile
scenes.motionDesc: Pip tilts her head to listen; the firefly's wings buzz a faint, wobbly hum and its glow flutters once.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: You don't peep like me. You go... kw-kwak! That's okay. Stay right there.

scenes.goal: Mo arrives, eager to help and fix it fast.
scenes.visualDesc: Two-shot: Mo steps in beside Pip with his planted sturdy stance, leaning over the dim firefly with a concerned, ready-to-help look.
scenes.endPose: leaning forward, both feet planted, studying the firefly
scenes.motionDesc: Mo waddles in from the side and plants himself, bending down to peer at the tiny light, giving his scarf a quick tug.

lines.speaker: mo
lines.text: Hmm. It's cold and its light is nearly gone. Let's help it shine again.

scenes.goal: Bo arrives wary of the strange humming visitor.
scenes.visualDesc: Two-shot: Bo pokes her head up beside Pip, eyeing the firefly sideways through her round glasses, leaning back a little, unsure of the odd little stranger.
scenes.endPose: leaning back, one wingtip on her glasses, eyeing the firefly
scenes.motionDesc: Bo pops up, pushes her glasses up her beak, and leans away with a wary squint at the humming light.

lines.speaker: bo
lines.text: It goes kwak? A bug that goes kwak? I do not trust the kwak.

scenes.goal: The dedicated funny beat — Mo fans the firefly 'awake' and the gust tumbles everyone.
scenes.visualDesc: Wide shot: Mo flaps both wings hard to fan the firefly 'awake'; the gust bowls Bo over backward in a tumble of feathers while the firefly's glow shrinks even smaller.
scenes.endPose: Bo flat on her back with feet up, Mo frozen mid-flap looking sheepish
scenes.motionDesc: Mo flaps furiously; the wind blasts Bo head-over-tail with a soft tumble, leaves swirl up, and the firefly's light flickers down nearly to dark.

lines.speaker: mo
lines.text: Wake up, little light! More air!

lines.speaker: bo
lines.text: Whoaa— too much air! Not the kwak's friend, the WIND!

scenes.goal: They try louder cheering; the light only dims more.
scenes.visualDesc: Two-shot: Pip and Bo lean right over the firefly, beaks wide, cheering loudly; the firefly curls in on itself and its glow dips lower with every shout.
scenes.endPose: both mid-cheer, then faltering as the light shrinks
scenes.motionDesc: Pip and Bo bounce and call out loudly; with each shout the firefly shrinks smaller and its light fades, until they slowly stop, confused.

scenes.goal: Mo's quiet realisation — pushing and noise make it worse.
scenes.visualDesc: Close two-shot: Mo gently lowers Pip's wing with his own and hushes her; both go still and small over the faint firefly, voices dropping to a whisper.
scenes.endPose: Mo's wing softly over Pip's, both quiet and still
scenes.motionDesc: Mo settles his wing over Pip's to calm her, lowers his head, and softens his whole body; Pip stills too as they realise to stop pushing.

lines.speaker: mo
lines.text: Maybe... it doesn't need more. Maybe it needs less. Quiet. Warm.

scenes.goal: Night falls and cold sets in; the firefly's light is almost out.
scenes.visualDesc: Close-up: the firefly shivers on the cold leaf, its glow down to a single trembling pinprick; Pip's face hovers close, breath gentle, eyes shining with worry.
scenes.endPose: Pip very close, watching the tiny pinprick of light, holding still
scenes.motionDesc: The firefly trembles and its light shrinks to a single faint point; Pip leans in slowly and goes completely still, watching, careful.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: It's so cold now. Hold on, little one. We're here.

scenes.goal: The tender beat — wary Bo is the first to offer warmth to the stranger.
scenes.visualDesc: Close two-shot: Bo, glasses catching the starlight, gently cups her soft wing around the firefly to shelter it; Pip watches with a held, grateful look.
scenes.endPose: Bo's wing curled softly around the firefly, a tender held look between her and Pip
scenes.motionDesc: Bo slowly, carefully curls her wing around the tiny light to shield it from the cold; she and Pip share a long, soft look as the glow steadies a little.

lines.speaker: bo
lines.text: Okay, little kwak. I've got you. You can stay close to me.

scenes.goal: The three huddle quietly together around the firefly.
scenes.visualDesc: Wide shot: the three chicks press gently together into one soft fluffy huddle around the cupped firefly, wings overlapping, all perfectly still and quiet.
scenes.endPose: three chicks nestled in a single warm huddle, the firefly cradled at the centre
scenes.motionDesc: Pip, Mo and Bo settle in close, tucking their wings together into one warm dome around the firefly, breathing slow, holding the stillness.

lines.speaker: mo
lines.text: Shh. Together now. Warm and still.

scenes.goal: THE key moment — the glow slowly returns and lights up all three faces.
scenes.visualDesc: Wide shot pushing in slowly: at the centre of the huddle the firefly's glow swells from a pinprick to a warm golden light, brighter and brighter, washing all three little faces in gold.
scenes.endPose: three faces lit gold, eyes huge with wonder, the firefly blazing softly between them
scenes.motionDesc: The light grows steadily from a tiny point into a full warm glow; the camera pushes in gently as golden light blooms across the three awed faces.

scenes.goal: Payoff — the firefly rises bright and the sleeping sunflowers turn toward it.
scenes.visualDesc: Wide low shot: the firefly lifts up out of the huddle glowing strong, and the tall sunflowers behind gently turn and open their faces toward its little light; the three chicks look up together.
scenes.endPose: all three gazing up at the rising glow, sunflowers leaning toward it
scenes.motionDesc: The firefly drifts upward, bright and steady; the sunflowers slowly turn to follow it as the three chicks tip their heads back and beam.

lines.speaker: bo
lines.text: The flowers woke up too! Hooray for the little kwak!

scenes.goal: Pip restates the lesson in her own kid-words; warmth all round.
scenes.visualDesc: Close two-shot: Pip turns to Mo, the firefly's soft glow on her cheeks, a content little smile; Mo nods warmly back.
scenes.endPose: Pip smiling softly at Mo, both lit by the gentle firefly glow
scenes.motionDesc: Pip turns to Mo with a sleepy happy smile; Mo nods slowly, and the firefly's glow drifts warm over them both.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Little things don't need loud. They need warm, and quiet, and time.

lines.speaker: mo
lines.text: And a friend who is different is a friend all the same.

scenes.goal: Pip's closer line to camera, teasing the next adventure.
scenes.visualDesc: Close-up: Pip looks right into camera with the firefly glowing softly on her hat brim, giving her bright double-wink, warm and sleepy.
scenes.endPose: looking into camera, mid double-wink, firefly glowing on her hat brim
scenes.motionDesc: Pip beams into the lens, gives two quick winks with the same eye, and the firefly settles glowing on the brim of her straw hat.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Goodnight, little light. Until next time, friends!
